verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents one product-native bulk action: a single 'Publish draft policies' button that publishes every draft not requiring review at once. A one-click secure baseline also pre-fills organization-wide device policy. Beyond these narrow UI cases there is no general bulk-operation capability, and nothing shows bulk actions through the MCP server or service keys. Missing for 10: general multi-select bulk edit, assign or resolve across findings, controls and tasks; bulk operations exposed via MCP/API for AI agents; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: On the **Policies** page, choose **Publish draft policies** to publish drafts that don’t require review.
Applying the secure defaults pre-fills settings as your organization-wide device policy
